model.short_description: Standalone FLUX.2 Klein 4B text-to-image FXBEX for Furiosa RNGD; exact package passed offline NPU inference.
model.readme:
Standalone text-to-image package with the model weights and saved Furiosa SDK Runnables. This release was tested from the exact `.fxbex` file in a fresh offline process on a Furiosa RNGD NPU.

## Generate an image

Install the current FXBEX runtime and matching Furiosa SDK/driver on an RNGD host. Then download the `.fxbex` release from the Files tab.

```python
from fxbex import ImageGeneration

with ImageGeneration("model.fxbex") as model:
    result = model.generate(
        "A small red fox beside a mountain lake at sunrise, golden autumn trees",
        steps=4, seed=20261102, width=512, height=512,
    )
print(result["image_path"])
```

## Tested scope

- Text-to-image at 512×512, BF16, four denoising steps, sequence length 128, fusion8 / Single mesh.
- Exact 15,999,871,549-byte standalone package tested with HF model cache inaccessible and offline mode enabled.
- Three same-seed image outputs had identical SHA256 `dc836e4b699d78ad2454981a8408d32f76eb44b0de9e1c0657e64e272a9a0615`; each image was 512×512 with 158,026 unique colors.
- Official RNGD trace: 9,708 NPU Task events, zero SDK CPU executions, zero unknown graphs. SDK CPU fallback disabled; 205 captured Runnables replayed; no compilation during package loading; no external HF cache reads.
- Image editing and other resolutions, step counts, precisions, or sequence lengths are not validated.

Model source: [Black Forest Labs FLUX.2 Klein 4B](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B), pinned to `e7b7dc27f91deacad38e78976d1f2b499d76a294`. Upstream weights are licensed under Apache-2.0; the upstream license is included in this repository. Bundled adapter code has no separate license declared. No Furiosa SDK binaries are bundled.
